statute_note: Two editions are finalized. The LankaLaw HTML edition (lankalaw.net/.../2001Y3V60C.html) prints an amendment chain ending at Act No. 5 of 1993 and so predates the 2022 Act; the consolidated PDF carries the chain through the Wills (Amendment) Act, No. 29 of 2022, and its sections 2, 3, 4, 7 and 9 read as that Act left them. Neither edition names a publisher on the page. Three of the five amending instruments -- Ordinances No. 11 of 1852, No. 15 of 1876 and No. 1 of 1911 -- are not held in any archive and are known only from the chain printed in the consolidated editions.
